use_case_summary: Mobile-first social gaming app: low-latency in-game text chat + ephemeral chatrooms. Need hosted API to avoid infra ops. Primary concerns: message moderation (abuse, spam, hate), per-user rate limiting, end-to-end p95 latency under 150ms for short prompt-response flows. Also interested in embeddings for search but not a blocker. Cost sensitive — aiming to keep monthly spend <$15k initially.
notes:
Lead: Samir (CTO/dev lead). Team of 18, quick iteration cycle. Came in via blog post about real-time streaming. They self-provisioned keys and ran a small smoke test.

Call notes (2026-01-22):
- Wants "feel" of chat to be instant — target <150ms p95 for local users. On-device latency (rendering + network) budget tight.
- Concern: false positives in moderation will hurt retention — needs granular control and auditability.
- Asked: can Redwood hosted API surface moderation labels + confidence scores? (Yes, talk through risk config)

Technical notes:

- Wants streaming/partial generation support for progressive UI.
- Wants examples for mobile exponential backoff and client-side deduping for spam.

Security/procurement:
- Submitted lightweight security questionnaire. Main asks: audit log retention (90 days vs 365), data residency (NA only), SAML SSO for admin console.
- Will require email to CTO with pricing and sample SLA language.
